name: motif_edit_allomorph_condition
description:
Edit an allomorph condition. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use only if one form's environments are wrong; otherwise fix the shared environment itself. Write environments with natural classes; under HermitCrab a regular alternation can instead be one phonological rule (guide conditioned-allomorphs). Changes the environment references on one existing stem or affix allomorph after checking its current list. Shared environments remain unchanged for every other allomorph that uses them. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-allomorph-condition. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id of the existing stem or affix allomorph.

expected_environments.description: Current environment ids; order matters only for position.

environments.description: Requested environment ids; order matters only for position.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
